candidate.name: quarterly_profit_growth_level_acceleration_floor_2r
candidate.formula: Attach the latest separately effective profit_yoy and profit_yoy_acceleration states, compute their same-stock-day average-tie percentile ranks on the exact common finite two-state cross-section, and return min(r_profit_level,r_profit_acceleration).
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Strong current profit growth that is also accelerating relative to the same fiscal quarter one year earlier is less likely to be a decelerating high base or a rebound from a weak level; the weakest-link state may remain under-repriced from the next open through the third close.
candidate.same_fiscal_quarter_rule: Within each instrument and report month, sort by report_date and compute current finite profit_yoy minus the immediately preceding report-year finite profit_yoy. Q1, Q2, Q3, and annual Q4 compare only with their own prior-year fiscal quarter; never bridge report months.
candidate.availability_rule: The current level and the acceleration derived from the newer report become usable only on the first accepted local session strictly after that report's announcement_date.
candidate.same_effective_date_rule: Sort instrument, effective session, report_date, and announcement_date, then retain the last report per instrument and effective session before state propagation.
candidate.state_rule: Forward-fill finite profit_yoy and profit_yoy_acceleration independently inside each instrument after strict effective-session ordering; never backfill from a later disclosure.
candidate.cross_section_rule: For every stock day, require both states finite and compute pandas-compatible average-tie percentile ranks separately over exactly that common finite two-state identity cross-section.
candidate.combination_rule: Exactly min(r_profit_level,r_profit_acceleration); no average, product, maximum, gap, fitted weight, alternate rank universe, or third component.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, unavailable or nonfinite current/prior same-quarter profit_yoy, missing acceleration, either nonfinite rank, or a result outside (0,1]. Never impute, clip, winsorize, substitute, backfill, choose a favorable report, or rank on a different universe.
candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 source values, pandas average-tie pct ranks, and numpy-compatible elementwise minimum. Reject rather than clip a nonfinite or out-of-range score.
